dedupeResult: The active pull-request repository was searched for both platform names, canonical domains, submission hosts and the visible DailyPlaylists support address before creation. No existing music-submission-agent records were returned. Soundplate's Spotify and Deezer variants are consolidated into one opportunity because they are alternate authorization paths within the same submission system. DailyPlaylists' free Standard, paid credit and Professional variants are consolidated into one opportunity, with the free Standard route designated as primary and all payment boundaries excluded from automatic execution.
emailVerificationLevel: DailyPlaylists publishes info@dailyplaylists.com on its official homepage, pricing page and FAQ. It was checked for syntax, first-party domain alignment and business-support relevance and was classified as support rather than a music-delivery mailbox. Soundplate's authorized submission route is platform-based and no public music-submission mailbox was identified or inferred. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No account was created or accessed; no Spotify or Deezer profile was connected; no OAuth permission, automatic follow, platform term, login, session, cookie, CAPTCHA, anti-spam or anti-bot control was accepted, handled or bypassed; no track, Spotify link, playlist selection, curator pitch, metadata or other asset was submitted; no Standard Submission, Premium Credit, add-on, Professional subscription, advertising product or payment was purchased or initiated; no email was sent; no contact was guessed; and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probing was performed.
